title: International Maritime Organization
definition: The International Maritime Organization (IMO) is a specialized agency of the United Nations responsible for regulating international shipping safety, security, and the prevention of marine and atmospheric pollution by ships.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for UPSC Prelims (international organizations, UN specialized agencies, headquarters, conventions) and Mains GS Paper II (international relations, global governance) & GS Paper III (environment, marine pollution, infrastructure, blue economy).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of International Maritime Organization.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Core foundational concepts of international relations
